title: A message from the travel agent
instructions: Seyahat acentesi kısa bir sesli mesaj bırakıyor. Kısa ama değişen bilgilere dikkat et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Hello Mr Smith, this is Sun Travel.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Your flight to Rome is now at nine forty, not seven forty.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Your hotel is the same, but your room has a sea view now.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please come to our office on Friday to get your tickets.

questions.prompt: Where is Mr Smith flying to?
What time is the flight now?
questions.feedback: Uçuş artık dokuz kırkta, yedi kırk değil.
questions.evidence: is now at nine forty, not seven forty.

questions.prompt: How much later is the flight?
What is new about the room?
questions.feedback: Otel aynı ama odada artık deniz manzarası var.
questions.evidence: your room has a sea view now.

questions.prompt: When should Mr Smith go to the office?
questions.feedback: Biletleri almak için cuma günü ofise gitmeli.
questions.evidence: Please come to our office on Friday
